# grpc-json-transcoding

Transcode REST JSON requests to gRPC messages by the google.api.http rules: path templates, body and query binding, additional bindings and proto3 JSON names NuGet package `Trysac.GrpcJsonTranscoding`, namespace `Trysac.GrpcJsonTranscoding`, MIT licensed, .NET >= 10, base class library only.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the library and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
